tasks.title: TOTP, encrypted seeds, recovery codes and key parsing have independently checked primitives
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, new pure crypto and key modules; Required behavior: TOTP, Seed encryption (key reader and envelope), Recovery codes (generation, normalisation and digest); Acceptance evidence 4 and unit portions of 8-9; Counterexamples: TOTP window/input, recovery input, key format and envelope. Inject randomness and clock; use node:crypto without a new package. Store/replay transactions follow in T2 and HTTP use follows in T3. Record the existing bun run test duration before implementation for the final PR comparison.

acceptance.command: bun test src/totp.test.ts src/secret-box.test.ts src/secret-key.test.ts src/recovery-codes.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail in selected tests; focused coverage may exit nonzero. RFC 6238 Appendix B SHA-1 seed 12345678901234567890 yields six-digit values 287082, 081804, 050471, 005924, 279037, 353130 at the six specified times; base32 is GEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQGEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQ. Window is c-1 through c+1, lowest matching step greater than last_step; boundaries 29999/30000 ms differ. Envelope is v1 with 12-byte nonce, 20-byte encrypted seed and 16-byte tag; wrong key, tampering, wrong user and malformed envelopes return typed failure. Ten distinct recovery codes have eight groups of four lowercase hex digits and independent node:crypto SHA-256 digests; collisions redraw. Strict key reader accepts 64 lowercase hex characters with at most one trailing LF and rejects the spec's invalid formats and admin-token equality with the literal errors.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; new modules follow injected dependency and explicit typed-failure conventions without changing packages or tooling thresholds

Implement pending-row ownership/expiry and the complete BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions for factor consumption/session rotation and authenticator confirmation/recovery-set replacement/revoking all sessions. Map Acceptance evidence 1 policy cases, 2 database migration assertions, 3/5 atomic replay and restart storage cases, 6 session storage isolation, and Counterexamples replay/partial expiry. Keep migration 1 unchanged. Adapt existing session callers/fixtures as needed so the pre-integration server and full suite remain green; update the startup newer-schema fixture from version 2 to version 3 and error suffix (2). main.ts wires expiry of both sessions and pending rows at start. HTTP stage enforcement and upgrade HTTP assertions are T3.

acceptance.expected: 0 fail in selected tests; focused coverage may exit nonzero. Owner requires a factor; signInStage returns full/enrol/factor/factor for the four literal cases in acceptance 1. A new database and a literal #562 schema-1 fixture migrate to user_version 2; instance and user fields are byte-equal and legacy sessions count is 0. Partial sessions and pending rows are live at t+899999 and expired at t+900000; full sessions retain the 2592000000 ms idle expiry and 60000 ms touch. tasks.title: Owners enrol an authenticator and complete a replay-safe second factor before protected access
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console, authentication integration; Required behavior: Session stages and access gate (home, factor and authenticator routes; T4 adds the account overview/code-renewal/session routes), Setup step, Password sign-in, TOTP, Seed encryption, Recovery codes at enrolment and sign-in, Enrolment and replacement, Second factor at sign-in, HTTP rules and Intended disclosures for these routes. Move shared context/response/form helpers into http-context.ts, preserve raw-path matching and enforce declared access after phase/Host before Origin/body; full-with-required-but-missing-authenticator is effectively enrol. Integrate optional startup key, warning/hasSecretKey, strict startup failures and 900-second partial cookies without extending partial stages. Enrolment and full-session replacement are one algorithm and belong together, including password recheck, ten codes, revocation and new full session. Reuse the existing password limiter and add the separate account/client factor limiter without changing auth-throttle.ts. Implement corresponding metrics/logs, escaping, no-store/CSP and responsive forms; update existing HTTP test fixtures and docs together. Acceptance evidence 1 (setup/home/policy; other protected account pages complete in T4), 2-4, 5 (creation, storage, sign-in and single use; renewal is T4), 7-10 for these flows; all applicable Counterexamples, including input budgets, window/replay, gate, partial/pending expiry and replacement. Server TOTP expected codes use an independent node:crypto helper checked against RFC vectors, never src/totp.ts.

acceptance.command: bun test src/server.factor.test.ts src/server.recovery.test.ts src/server.upgrade.test.ts src/server.setup.test.ts src/server.sign-in.test.ts
acceptance.expected: 0 fail in selected tests; focused coverage may exit nonzero. Finish setup and owner password without an authenticator redirect 303 to /account/authenticator; protected home redirects until confirmation returns 200 with exactly 10 distinct recovery codes. An enrolled password redirects 303 to /sign-in/factor; successful TOTP or recovery rotates cookie/CSRF and redirects to safe next_path. Reused TOTP/recovery gives 401, survives reopening and has exactly one 303 winner under concurrent posts; time rollback and c±2 fail, c±1 can succeed. Invalid/both/no code fields give 422 without failures. Five mixed wrong factors lock the sixth attempt with 429 and Retry-After 900; a correct password does not reset it, t5+899999 remains locked and t5+900000 permits success. Replacement requires password, leaves the confirmed factor unchanged until confirmation, then revokes other sessions/old codes. Schema-1 upgrade closes setup with 404, rejects old cookie with 303 to /sign-in?next=%2F and requires enrolment after password.
